cat_keep_shapes_tensors: concatenate a list of PyTorch tensors while preserving their original shapes for later uncat
uncat_with_shapes_tensors: split a flattened tensor back into a list of tensors using previously saved shapes and token counts
named_replace_module: recursively replace child modules in a PyTorch nn.Module by applying a callable function to each
named_apply_module: recursively apply a callable function to each named module in a PyTorch nn.Module tree
fix_random_seeds: fix all random seeds for PyTorch, CUDA, NumPy, and Python random to ensure reproducibility
